output.population: 3,549 patients who were survivors of myocardial infarction within the preceding 2 years with 6 or more PVCs per hour on a qualifying Holter recording; ejection fraction limits applied by enrollment window
output.summary: RR interval data from the Cardiac Arrhythmia Suppression Trial, testing whether suppressing ventricular premature complexes after myocardial infarction improves survival. Enrollment required a recent MI and frequent PVCs on Holter recording.
